text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Ah, no way... It can't be true...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Geez!!
I'm such an idiot, idiot, idiot—!!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
If only I knew there was a sale...
I wouldn't have stocked up on Toughness Bars earlier~~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Ines Fujin felt utterly defeated
for failing to check the sale information.
